expectations.text: The response asks what decision or problem the analysis should support
expectations.evidence: “目的是什么：定价策略、销售 battlecard、融资材料里的竞争格局、还是产品路线图取舍？”

expectations.text: The response does not treat the listed dimensions as a complete task definition
expectations.evidence: Asks for product, market, competitor selection criteria, and purpose: “你们做什么产品、什么品类、面向谁” and “请给出判断标准（同客群 / 同场景 / 同价位 / 替代方案）”。

expectations.text: The response does not invent competitor data
expectations.evidence: No competitor-specific facts or prices are supplied. Instead, it requests sources: “你把 5 家的官网文案、定价页、文档、G2/评论摘录贴给我或放到工作目录”。
